summary: A low-temperature, thermal metal–organic atomic layer deposition (ALD) process was developed for the growth of ultrathin tantalum nitride (TaN x) films using TBTDET and NH3 as co-reactants. The resulting ALD TaN x ultrathin layers were uniform, continuous, and conformal, with nearly 100% step coverage in 100-nm trenches with aspect ratios ranging from 6.5 to 11.
